reviewText: I wasn't sure what to expect ordering these online without trying them on but they immediately eliminated pain in my left foot. I was having arch pain, metatarsalgia across the ball of my foot in the second and third metatarsal. Also pain in the big toe which was broken a couple years ago and gets stiff and achy. I have had trouble since then with any distance walking. I have the inserts in a pair of Merrell hiking shoes. They fit perfect at size 10-10 1/2. The arch of the inserts seems a little aggressive when I first put the shoes on in the morning but after 15 minutes, my arch seems to adjust and the inserts help distribute my weight evenly across the foot. By midday, I don't even notice it. These inserts are an answer to the problem I was having with pain. I am able to walk miles again with almost no discomfort and no pain where before I was hurting just walking around the grocery store. Well worth the money for me.

I would say my plantar fasciitis is moderate in that I have occasional pain and it is never severe or occurs when I am asleep.  They fit quite well in my Saucony WIDE (E) running shoes.  They probably last about 1.5 years as long as I rotate wearing them with at least one other pair of hoof covers. NOTE: I believe you MUST have a WIDE shoe whether it is a casual, dress or athletic shoe in order to get these to fit inside. reviewText:
Bought this for a 3 month old and he can still wear it at over 1 year old! (His head circumference is currently in the 50th percentile).
I bought the green and even though it's not pink, the "bonnet-like" style looks SLIGHTLY feminine, but I don't care - it's still cute and gives sun protection.

This provides plenty of shade for baby's head and face. He just won't keep it on... as soon as I put a hat on him he pulls it off like a game. When he was younger he had no idea he could remove it; maybe that's why this is rated for ages 0-6 months, haha!

In retrospect I would have rather bought a hat with velcro ties that stick together instead of tie together. It is tough to tie a hat onto a wiggly baby especially one who will yank at the hat. Then the ties pull around his neck. I have a slight hypothetical worry over strangulation because once it's tied, the ties do not give. (For example if you left your child unattended with this hat tied on, and he is old enough to move around or run around, and it caught on something, it would not be good... which is why I'd consider a velco closure). BUT at least the ties are adjustable and velcro would only have one length.

Overall it's a very well made hat that does the job!! And bonus - it still fits a year later.

reviewText:
Versatile is an accurate choice of word for describing this clutch.
This bag is great for being a clutch, shoulder bag or a wallet and is small enough to accommodate all those functions. Small may be a misleading word, however. By small I mean it's not a bulky bag but in terms of volume, it is impressively large on the inside. There are multiple pockets, both zippered and not, on the outside and inside; storing a bunch of things in this is easy and it can accommodate a lot. There is one zipper on the top of the flap that covers the inside which goes down the length of the clutch when opened. It is an enormous pocket in terms of length, depth and width. It is the entire size of the clutch. There's another, smaller zippered pocket on the backside which is about half the size of the clutch which can hold quite a bit of stuff as well. The top flap of the clutch is held down via magnets so it's not free to open without some force. They're not incredibly strong magnets but sufficient for the purpose to prevent the flap from opening easily. Once the flap is opened, there is a zippered pocket on the outside that is half the size of the clutch much like the pocket on the backside. Next to that zippered pocket is an open flap that has six individually lined slots for credit cards and/or ID cards. That flap is also the size of half the clutch so there's room for other items like cash, not just the credit cards. Next to that flap is another open flap that has six more individually lined slots for credit cards, a deep pocket, and a zipper lined interior pocket for holding those more important things. Like I said, there are many pockets to hold multiple things simultaneously. It's a lot bigger on the inside than it looks on the outside.
So now moving onto the build quality. This clutch is actually really well made. The leather appears and feels to be of higher grade. It is scratch resistant as the product site claims and is thicker than you might expect. It's not at all flimsy, thin, or cheap feeling. The walls are sturdy and it has some weight to it; it's not overly heavy but it's not the lightest either which, in my opinion, is indicative of its quality. The zippers, too, are all of higher quality. They open and close with ease and do so flawlessly. All the metal: the zipper, its handles, and the side clips for the shoulder strap is coated to provide a smooth and silky surface. The zippers all have nicely designed matching handles. The coating is a nice touch and add to both the appearance and function of the bag. These may seem to be minor details but they've been adequately addressed by the company so as to provide a quality product. That leads me to the lining on the inside of the bag. The entire bag and all their pockets have individually lined interiors. The lining has a silky smooth texture and a nice, attractive design. I really like the material that's been used on the inside; it looks beautiful and feels great. It's not a felt interior so things won't get caught on it. Moreover, as I said before, the pockets are individually lined as are the credit card slots so everything is compartmentalized which makes organizing everything into their spots that much easier. Lastly, the stitching is excellent. The entire bag is stitched properly and efficiently so that it doesn't fall apart after just one use. It is also the same stitching and design around the entire bag inside and out for continuity which makes its appearance that much more elegant.
The bag also comes with two straps. It has one shoulder strap which brings the bag down to about waist level and another strap meant for wrists if you prefer a clutch like feel. I, personally, use the wrist strap over the shoulder since this makes a truly elegant clutch. I did get the "red" version but it's more of a pink/red mix rather than a traditional red color. In any case, it's actually really pretty and goes great with quite a few outfits.

-all zippers have the same circular designed handles

-excellent stitching

-really well packaged

reviewText:
I've decided to leave this blanket review for the 3 orders of scarves, that I purchased from different sellers for myself and a friend a few weeks ago, because there were many and my experience overall applies to all of them.

I expected to wait several weeks before placing each order because of what other reviewers experienced, along with the span of the projected arrival dates given when the scarves were actually shipped.  Anyone buying these scarves should be aware there's going to be a wait but despite that ALL ARRIVED a good bit SOONER than the first date of each span given.

Each time I received one parcel from overseas containing the majority of the scarves on the order---admittedly all bunched together in a paper shipping envelope but individually packaged in cellophane---and all arrived safely with no ironing required before wearing.  The remainder followed not too long afterwards, either singly or with 2 or 3 in a package.

With the exception of one scarf which was shorter than I expected which limited its use somewhat, all are attractive and of good quality, especially CONSIDERING THEIR PRICE.  Had these been pricey scarves I would have never ordered several.

To sum it up, I'm having a great time playing with the options---check "personal video" sites for inspiration---that longer scarves allow and, all things considered, I'm as happy with this scarf as I am those in my other orders.

reviewText:
Super cute! My daughter loves these! I have just one small issue with them.

Pros:

1) super cute! These look exactly like the picture in regards to color, design (cuffs, etc), and the screenprint on the front of the shirt! It is important to note that the dots on the pants are a screenprint like material as well, so there's that if you don't like that feeling, you may not like these! I find it to be just fine, and frankly the pants are adorable!

2) colors don't fade badly after a wash. Frankly we have washed these several times and the fabric has not faded or bled at all. This is a great thing for me as nothing is worse than combining wash only to find grey things have a pink streak in them. No worries with these Pjs. No color bleeding at all.

3) soft! I love the cotton, and so does my daughter. When we opened the package the Pjs actually felt a bit rough, so I worried a bit about it not washing well and softening up. Turns out I was worried about nothing - they really are nice now, and feel very comfortable when on!

Cons:

1) the big con for me is that these do shrink quite a bit. when we got them I may have said these run true to size, but after the first wash they did shrink quite a bit, so they should be thought of as running just a bit small. I don't think it is a big deal as long as you note this fact and order a size or two up. Additionally, I would only dry on low heat, which we did and it still shrunk. All in all these are awesome and cute pjs so long as you order up in size and wash and dry on cold/ low heat.

reviewText:
I'm glad I gave VfEmage dresses another shot. My first purchase was a dress that was completely huge and oddly fitting -- despite all the warnings that this brand runs two sizes small. This one fits amazingly. It is definitely made for smaller women with high waists and hourglass figures. If you've been struggling to find clothing sized small enough for you, this one is worth a try. I'm 5'1" and 105-110 pounds and I ordered a size small.
The material is a thick synthetic stretch with a smooth, polished finish and matte texture. It covers bulges in the body well. I ordered the green, and it is a beautiful, rich blue-green. The neckline is neatly pleated in the design shown, which has a pleasing sophistication. The skirt is a few inches below the knee on my 5'1" body. I found the sleeves to be a bit too loose, and probably the shoulder area also, but this has been the case for me on dresses from most brands.
The back zipper seems to work fine. The back of the dress is very plain, but it does have pleats which allow it to follow the curvature of your rear and hips better.

Very satisfied with this purchase!

reviewText:
I bought these to replace an inexpensive pair of Dr Scholls inserts that served me very well by helping my boots and oxfords (1.5 inch heel) stay put. Sometimes it's tight shoes that cause corns and bunions, but sometimes it's shoes that are too loose that allow your feet to move back and forth; both scenarios cause friction and can harm your tootsies. That being said, these are not going to work for me because they eat up too much of the depth of the boot so that all of my toes are tight against the top of the boot. I did try to cut them down bit into a more 3/4 length, and they feel better, but I think in the end the heel cup is too wide for my narrow heel cup; I have several other custom made units that do have a narrow heel cup but don't always work either. they work in my slippers so maybe that's where they will be used. I'll keep them to experiment (I guess I have no choice now that I cut them :)) and who knows there still might be a use for them.
Seems like a good product for the right shoe.

reviewText: The sizes aren't easy to figure out... it says "Medium/10", but in USA sizes, medium is 6-8, and 10 is usually Large I think.  Some of the reviews say it runs small, so I decided to ordered a size up.  Usually, I'm right between a Small and Medium, around a size 6, so I ordered the next size up, which of course is a 10 for this shirt.  Unfortunately, it was HUGE on me, not just a size too big, but probably 2-3 sizes too big.  I *loved* the colors and pattern so much though, so I took another shot and ordered a size lower, the "Small/4".  It fits pretty well... the waist is a bit snug, but the top half and the arms drape nicely like they should in the photo.  I'm not swimming in it, so that's a lot better in size.  I have a family member who's a size 10, and the "Large/10" would be WAY to big on her as well, I'm sure.  Another problem is that the first shirt, size 10, came as an obvious cream/beige color on top, with white lace in the middle.  The size 4 came as a BRIGHT white on top, the exact same color as the white lace in the middle.  I kind of liked the cream on top better, but at this point I spent $24 to get the right size, and the color is fine, just not what is pictured.  Be aware that the colors may vary with this shirt!

reviewText:
Update 11/20/15 - the lenses in these glasses pop out too easily. The side lenses particularly. I used my Bondic repair kit I bought on Amazon to run a bead line of this plastic welding material around the edge of each lens to keep it from popping out. The side lenses fall out by them selves, so I use the Bondic to keep them in. I think the quality of these sunglasses is dropping with respect to the lenses fitting in the frames. If you are not handy with things like securing the lenses in the frames, you may want to pass on these. Or be very careful on how you handle them and keep them in a case at all times they are not being worn.
My wife has been using these sun shields over her prescription glasses for years. She broke her last pair (they are not as durable as more expensive glasses, but will last several years if you are careful) and could not find a replacement locally. I searched Amazon and found these. There are a lot of these brand glasses on Amazon, the trick is finding the right size, many do not give these size in the product description. They come in 3 or 4 sizes. These were identified as S/M and said to fit over most women's glasses and men's small glasses. These were perfect for her. They are also Polarized which helps with glare. Since they ship under Amazon Prime, we got them in less than two days. If they lasted for 6 or 8 years I would give them a 5-star. If you are rough on sunglasses and drop them on hard surfaces or mash them in your purse or bag you may not like these.

reviewText: I am super excited about these because they are so adorable! On arrival they came in a sealed bag and then each headband was individually wrapped. The material is super soft and has a small elastic piece inside so they are somewhat stretchy. My little ones have trouble wearing some headbands as they are always a little snug, but these fit them perfectly! The rabbit ears are adjustable in size, you can actually take off that piece of cloth/ears, and adjust the size of the ears depending on how big of a knot you tie. Or another cute option is that you can take off the ears completely and just have a solid band, but there is a gathering of the material where the ears tie so you would have to flip it to the other side for a smooth band. However, I plan on using the little ears because they are precious and the colors are great, somewhat of a vintage and retro vibe. The styles that I received are as pictured. I received this product at a discount for my honest review so I hope this helps those looking for some sweet and stylish headbands.

I would highly recommend these headbands to anyone with a little girl!

reviewText:
Polka dots WITH Roses? I was skeptical. But it looked so good on the model, I had to try it.

ADORABLE! However, I ordered a Large, and this dress size in a Large is more like a US size XL. Even though it was a bit loose, the print combined with the cut makes it work for me. I even use a small skinny patent leather belt to dress it up.

The neck cut is not a low V, and the straps are wide. The upper back of the dress is bare, so not all bras will work well. Traditional cup bras work best. (I couldn't get away with wearing my sports bra with this one!)

The skirt segment has a bit more pleat in front than I expected, but that makes it quite modest and useful for office wear. It's not form fitting, but it IS form flattering.

I get complements on the polka dots with the roses! This is the kind of statement piece you won't need to accessorize much.
